fields.name: store
fields.expression: [n \in DOMAIN s.store |-> [s.store[n] EXCEPT !.hash = IF s.store[n].hash = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1]]

fields.name: memory
fields.expression: [q \in DOMAIN s.memory |-> [n \in DOMAIN s.memory[q] |-> [s.memory[q][n] EXCEPT !.hash = IF s.memory[q][n].hash = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1, !.candidate = 0]]]

fields.name: state
fields.expression: [s EXCEPT !.requests = [i \in DOMAIN s.requests |-> IF s.requests[i].phase \in {"response", "done"} THEN <<s.requests[i].phase, s.requests[i].committed, s.requests[i].purpose, (s.requests[i].status > 0 => s.requests[i].noStore), (s.requests[i].result = "existing" => (s.requests[i].captured.exists /\ s.requests[i].captured.family = s.requests[i].family /\ ~s.requests[i].chainCalled /\ s.requests[i].committed = 0 /\ s.requests[i].responseRevision = s.requests[i].current)), (s.requests[i].result = "registered" => (s.requests[i].committed > 0 /\ s.requests[i].responseRevision = s.requests[i].committed)), (s.requests[i].result = "pending" => s.requests[i].committed = 0), (s.requests[i].result = "funds" => (s.requests[i].mode = "get" /\ s.requests[i].purpose = 2))>> ELSE [s.requests[i] EXCEPT !.expected = IF s.requests[i].mode = "get" THEN 1 ELSE s.requests[i].expected, !.transaction = IF s.requests[i].mode \in {"get", "review"} THEN 1 ELSE s.requests[i].transaction, !.family = IF s.requests[i].mode \in {"get", "review"} THEN "evm" ELSE s.requests[i].family]]]

fields.name: state
fields.expression: [s EXCEPT !.legacyCache = [k \in DOMAIN s.legacyCache |-> [version |-> 0, subject |-> 0]], !.loginVersion = [a \in DOMAIN s.loginVersion |-> 0], !.dataVersion = IF s.dataVersion > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0, !.cache = [k \in DOMAIN s.cache |-> [s.cache[k] EXCEPT !.version = IF s.cache[k].version > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0]], !.requests = [id \in DOMAIN s.requests |-> LET r == s.requests[id] IN IF r.phase \in {"response", "done"} THEN [r EXCEPT !.method = "GET", !.transport = TRUE, !.expected = 0, !.loginValid = TRUE, !.repository = 1, !.cacheEnabled = TRUE, !.login = 0, !.selectedExpected = 0, !.delivered = FALSE, !.key = IF r.putPending THEN r.key ELSE 0, !.payload = IF r.putPending THEN (IF r.payload > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0) ELSE 0, !.waitUntil = IF r.putPending THEN r.waitUntil ELSE FALSE] ELSE IF r.phase = "dispatch" /\ ~r.putPending /\ ((r.method # "GET" /\ ~r.transport) \/ ~(IF r.route = "actor-selection" THEN r.method = "POST" ELSE r.method = "GET" /\ r.route # "unknown")) THEN [r EXCEPT !.expected = 0, !.repository = 1, !.cacheEnabled = TRUE, !.waitUntil = FALSE, !.loginValid = TRUE, !.login = 0, !.payload = IF r.payload > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0] ELSE [r EXCEPT !.login = 0, !.payload = IF r.payload > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0]]]
